verdict.rationale: Lovable lets users download the full codebase or sync it to GitHub/GitLab, giving open, editable code export, but this covers only the application code, not the underlying app data (database records, auth users, storage) which lives in Lovable's Cloud/Supabase backend with no documented bulk data-export or account-deletion/portability flow. missing for 10: documented export of database/user data in an open format, and a clear account-deletion/data-takeout process independent of code export.
